keyframes.name: pulse-bolt
keyframes.css: @keyframes pulse-bolt { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px hsl(var(--gold) / 0.6)); } 50% { opacity: 0.85; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 16px hsl(var(--gold) / 0.9)); } }

keyframes.name: fade-up
keyframes.css: @keyframes fade-up { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

keyframes.name: light-sweep
keyframes.css: @keyframes light-sweep { 0% { transform: translateX(-120%) skewX(-18deg); opacity: 0; } 20% { opacity: 0.65; } 100% { transform: translateX(220%) skewX(-18deg); opacity: 0; } }

keyframes.name: arc-flicker
keyframes.css: @keyframes arc-flicker { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0; stroke-dashoffset: 800; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px hsl(var(--gold)/0.6)); } 8% { opacity: 1; } 14% { opacity: 0.4; } 20% { opacity: 0.95; } 30% { opacity: 0; stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }

keyframes.name: spark-rise
keyframes.css: @keyframes spark-rise { 0% { transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.6); opacity: 0; } 20% { opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translateY(-180px) scale(1.1); opacity: 0; } }
